answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer posts a 200-unit bond and a verifiable work signal, then stands on a narrow ledge: each epoch, three unseen peers audit its tasks, and one failed audit slashes the bond and removes it. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 units, while caught fakes earn nothing. An honest agent pays once, passes, and keeps its harbor among honest agents, earning undiluted rewards.
